record.content: Independence Area Trails map, page 1, upper Taboose panel (edition unstated): highlighted trail connects the marked Taboose trailhead to Taboose Pass at the Forest Service / Kings Canyon boundary. It crosses John Muir Wilderness on the eastern approach. Map supports a continuous bidirectional trail, not exact mileage.
